title: Corticotropin-releasing factor mRNA is expressed in the inferior olives of rodents and primates.
abstract: Immunohistochemical studies have suggested that corticotropin-releasing factor (CRF) was a transmitter of the olivocerebellar projection. We used in situ hybridization histochemistry with a 35S-labeled oligodeoxyribonucleotide probe for CRF mRNA to show that inferior olivary neurons of rats, baboons, and humans synthesize CRF.
